title: A tiny event bus
prompt: Implement nested class `Solution.EventBus`: `event Action<string>? OnMessage;`, `void Publish(string message)` (invokes subscribers with the message; safe when none), `void Subscribe(Action<string> handler)`, `void Unsubscribe(Action<string> handler)`. Subscribers run in subscription order.
